new_today_news.headline: Why Grease Matters: Failures Contribute to 22% of Restaurant Fires
new_today_news.summary: Highlights critical importance of grease trap maintenance for food service establishments, noting that failure to clean hood vents and manage FOG contributes to 22% of all restaurant fires and millions in damages annually.

recent_news.headline: FOG-Related SSOs and Consent Decrees: Understanding the Hidden Costs
recent_news.summary: Baltimore, the Metropolitan St. Louis Sewer District, Miami-Dade County, and Fort Smith, Arkansas have all had FOG named specifically in their consent decrees, illustrating how patterns of FOG-related overflows trigger multi-year federal enforcement actions. The article explains how FOG prevention programs become federal consent decree obligations with ongoing inspection and reporting requirements.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported net income of $387.3 million ($2.41 per diluted share) for Q2 2026, significantly outperforming analyst estimates of $1.27 EPS. Combined Adjusted EBITDA reached $741.7 million, a 197% increase from Q2 2025's $249.5 million. The company noted strong fat and protein prices, improved trade conditions, and solid operational execution.

recent_news.headline: GFL Environmental Reports Q2 2026 Earnings; CEO Comments on Take-Private Interest
recent_news.summary: GFL Environmental reported strong Q2 2026 results with 11% revenue growth to $3.59 billion year-to-date and 13.7% adjusted EBITDA growth to $1.07 billion. The company raised full-year 2026 guidance for the second time, citing continued acquisition activity and underlying business strength. CEO Patrick Dovigi addressed recent unsolicited preliminary expressions of interest regarding taking the company private.
